definition: Physical engineering features that protect infrastructure against an identified natural hazard. Includes elevation, protective drainage, flood barriers, waterproofing, reinforced structures, protected cables and heat-resistant components. Location, route and deployment-mode choices are climate_informed_siting; risk assessment is cra. Excludes generic resilience claims, routine maintenance and reconstruction without an identifiable protective improvement. Drainage or flood works qualify only when protecting an identifiable asset, not merely because they are project investments. The asset may be identified through supplied context.
